source.title: Frisch scheme identification: Results and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as one zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 683408.

Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/683408 returned HTTP 403, classified as blocked_or_challenged. The zbMATH REST API resolved the identifier to Zbl 0925.93172, Guidorzi, R. P., 'Frisch scheme identification: Results and open problems,' in Systems and networks: mathematical theory and applications, MTNS '93, Volume II, Math. Res. 79, pages 177-182, 1994, with no DOI, arXiv identifier, or full-text link exposed.
Citation matching confirmed the same exact zbMATH record, title, author, pagination, and 1994 proceedings source. This was used only as identity metadata, not as technical source text for extraction.

Failure mode: metadata_only with blocked_or_challenged direct resolver access. Bounded exact-work recovery searched by exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus author/source/pagination, and ISBN/proceedings identifiers. The University of Bologna author page and the Polimi publications PDF list only bibliographic entries; Crossref and OpenAlex returned no exact-work full-text record; Eindhoven, MTMT, LIBRIS, and bookseller pages describe the host proceedings or neighboring chapters only. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the article text was recovered.

Source adequacy gate failed: the workflow forbids extracting open problems from zbMATH metadata, author publication lists, citation matching output, search snippets, or host-proceedings metadata when the problem statements themselves are not visible in a readable primary source artifact.
Saved JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/683408.json and outputs/latest.json.
